items.title: Leave your accommodation
items.body: Walking from Plaza Nueva via Cuesta de Gomérez is 25–30 min uphill, steep. A taxi from the centre to Puerta de la Justicia is ~10 min. On foot you'll pass under the Puerta de las Granadas (1536, marked 'A' on your paper map) — a triumphal arch with three carved pomegranates on top; the path forks just past it, take the left/uphill fork for the Gate of Justice.

items.title: Be at the Puerta de la Justicia queue (paper guide #1)
items.body: Staff usually start scanning tickets around 08:00–08:15; gates open at 08:30. Bring both passports — tickets are nominative and they check.

items.title: Through security & ticket scan
items.body: Walk up past the Puerta del Vino into Plaza de los Aljibes.

items.title: Quick look at Puerta del Vino & the Alcazaba walls
items.body: The Alcazaba interior is closed this year — view from Plaza de los Aljibes only. Then walk east along the front of the Palace of Charles V.

items.title: Queue at the Mexuar door
items.body: The Nasrid Palaces entrance is on the north side of Calle Real, just past the Palace of Charles V. There will already be a line.

items.title: Enter the Mexuar — Nasrid Palaces begin
items.body: One-way from here: Mexuar → Cuarto Dorado → Court of the Myrtles → Sala de la Barca → (Hall of the Ambassadors closed) → Court of the Lions and its four halls → Mirador de Lindaraja → Emperor's Chambers.

items.title: El Partal
items.body: You exit the palaces directly into the Partal Gardens: Torre de las Damas, the oratory, the Nasrid houses, the reflecting pool.

items.title: Paseo de las Torres
items.body: Torre de la Cautiva and Torre de las Infantas — the quietest stretch of the whole visit.

items.title: Cross the footbridge to the Generalife
Generalife
items.body: Jardines Nuevos → Patio de la Acequia → Patio del Ciprés de la Sultana → Escalera del Agua → Jardines Altos → Paseo de las Adelfas.

items.title: Walk back toward Calle Real
items.body: Via the Cuesta de los Chinos / through the Partal.

items.title: Calle Real
items.body: Santa María de la Alhambra, Baño de la Mezquita. Coffee option at the Parador (old Convent of San Francisco).

items.title: Palace of Charles V + museums
items.body: Alhambra Museum (free) and Fine Arts Museum. No timed entry, so save it for whenever you need an indoor, unhurried break.

items.title: Alcazaba viewpoint & exit
items.body: Last look at the Alcazaba from Plaza de los Aljibes, exit via Puerta de la Justicia.

items.title: Optional: Mirador de San Nicolás
items.body: Sunset ≈ 20:18. Be in place by 19:45 for the golden hour on the Comares Tower, from across the valley in the Albaicín.
